falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $72,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakout above the August 2024 local high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below that resistance level. It would signal renewed bullish momentum rather than continued consolidation or downside.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on BTC perpetual swaps turns positive (>0.01%) and stays positive for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent positive funding indicates leveraged longs are paying shorts, suggesting bullish sentiment and positioning. This contradicts the HOLD signal and bottoming pattern, which typically features negative or neutral funding as shorts dominate.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC spot ETF daily net inflows exceed $500M on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A massive single-day inflow would demonstrate institutional buying pressure strong enough to overwhelm the current supply/demand balance. This would invalidate the HOLD verdict by showing aggressive accumulation rather than the indecision implied by the current signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
